method: vertices merged at 1e-5; face connectivity components; bbox in GLB units (x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1)

islands.role: figures F1 (front) + F2 (rear) fused at a contact slab
lower leg + plantigrade five-toed foot study (wrapped)

figure_split: components 0 and 5 split by removing faces in the contact slab and reassigning them to the nearest large component (split.py)

F1.assessment: complete front and back (mane, back musculature), complete shanks and feet under wraps, small open seam on the -X arm at the F1/F2 contact; long loincloth, belts, pouches, bracers, armbands, necklace, braids, shin wraps

F2.assessment: rear figure; its anterior side is a second back (hallucinated) - unusable

F3.assessment: back opened at the F3/F4 contact

F4.assessment: good front and legs, integrated tail; upper back disorganised by the back-to-back fusion with F3

selected: F1 (primary full-body source). Defects lie in zones that need surgical work anyway; F4 back is disorganised. Tail from the separate tail study (component 4).
correction: The 05N session first read F1 as missing the anterior shins and F4 as hollow-backed. Both were a renderer clipping artifact (camera clip_end 1000 at distance 1000, half the body clipped). Fixed (clip_end 5000) and re-rendered before any decision was finalised; the F1 choice stands on the corrected renders.
